endpoint.text: The aim of the present study is to elucidate the antiobesity effects of BSPs by studying the metabolic profiles of serum obtained from subjects who have undergone dietary intervention with these peptides.

reported_results.text: In contrast to the total cholesterol concentration, HDL-cholesterol levels (𝑃 < 0.001) exhibited a marked increase at the end of the dietary intervention.Theconcentrationofthemacromolecularcomplex increased from 33.7 ± 1.37mg/dL to 39.3 ± 1.77mg/dL.
After completion of the test period, BMI and percent body fat of the test group were found to be 27.6 ± 0.48 and 31.3 ± 1.07%, respectively.
This result indicated that the study subjects who took BSP for the period of 12 weeks experienced changes in the profiles of the serum metabolites. 3.3.
